title: Banff National Park Small Group Tour with Expert Guide
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the stunning landscapes of Banff National Park on this exclusive small group tour. Visit iconic sites such as Johnston Canyon, Bow Falls, Moraine Lake (seasonal), the picturesque Lake Louise and a relaxed visit to the charming town of Banff. With a knowledgeable guide, discover the park’s fascinating history while enjoying breathtaking views year-round, from vibrant autumn hues to winter’s icy beauty. This journey includes round trip transportation and opportunities for wildlife sightings, ensuring an unforgettable experience in the heart of the Rockies.

- Full-day small group tour with a maximum of 12 guests
- Visit top attractions including Lake Louise, Moraine Lake and Johnston canyon
- Knowledgeable certified and local guide sharing insights about the park
- Includes transportation, entry fees, and bottled water throughout the day
